parsed.notes: The same table appears twice in the excerpt (notes and MD&A); it is reported once here. The leverage ratio is total debt to deemed consolidated EBITDA as defined in the agreements. The base limit is 3.75x. A qualified-acquisition step-up (Axonics, designated under the 2021 agreement and continued under the new agreements) stepped down to 4.00x as of 6/30/2026. Consolidated EBITDA excludes non-cash charges and net cash litigation payments up to $1.160B since 12/31/2025; $1.115B of that exclusion remained.
